question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**required**" means necessary for a particular purpose. (आवश्यक)
 
• In the context of the passage, **"required"** correctly indicates that a certain number of smog towers will be necessary to achieve the desired reduction in air pollution.
 
• The other options: "coerced," "negated," and "vexed" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** If smog towers were to be used to reduce air pollution in Delhi by 17 per cent, at least 40,000 of them will be required__, the affidavit stated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Coerced (बलपूर्वक)**: means persuaded (an unwilling person) to do something by using force or threats.
 
• **Negated (नकारा)**: means nullified or made ineffective.
 
• **Vexed (परेशान)**: means annoyed, frustrated, or worried.
